definitions.explanation: The eleventh month of the year. Late autumn with peak foliage in many areas and the Shichi-Go-San festival for children.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}は{寒|さむ}いです。
{十一月|じゅういちがつ}は{秋|あき}の{終|お}わりです。
examples.english: November is the end of autumn.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}は{紅葉|もみじ}がきれいです。
examples.english: The autumn leaves are beautiful in November.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}になると、{朝|あさ}はとても{寒|さむ}くなります。
examples.english: When November comes, mornings get very cold.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}の{十五日|じゅうごにち}は{七五三|しちごさん}で、{家族|かぞく}と{神社|じんじゃ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: November 15th is Shichi-Go-San, and families go to shrines.

notes:
{十一月|じゅういちがつ} is November, the eleventh month of the year.

FORMATION:
{十一|じゅういち} (eleven) + {月|がつ} (month)

SEASON:
Late autumn in Japan. {紅葉|もみじ} (autumn foliage) reaches its peak in many areas.

EVENTS:
- {七五三|しちごさん} (November 15): festival celebrating children aged 3, 5, and 7. Families visit shrines.
- {勤労感謝|きんろうかんしゃ}の{日|ひ} (November 23): Labor Thanksgiving Day (national holiday)

RELATED:
- {十月|じゅうがつ}: October
- {十二月|じゅうにがつ}: December
